skillNamesFr.freshness: Its OWN key because availability is independent of the skills pipeline: only the Pages and clone channels serve French (npm 2.0.0 exports English and German only), so an npm-fallback run refreshes skills.json and leaves this table untouched. A sourceVersion older than the skills entry means the last import ran without a French channel, not that anything failed.
